title: ascend-operator-tuning
summary: Run a staged, accuracy-gated tuning campaign on a single Ascend NPU operator: set a numeric target up front, block tuning until an on-device accuracy pass is logged, escalate code-level then scheduling then instruction-level tuning with per-stage stall counters and kill-switches, and route each change by the metric contract (core utilization, bubble rate, load balance). Use after ascend-operator-profiling has measured a baseline and the operator is confirmed as the bottleneck.
